title: Refund lane service targets, undisputed-portion release and RSL inputs
scope: Extend the TAX-048 lanes with configurable proposed decision-time targets per lane, the calculated undisputed portion, structural-explanation tests first, and new inputs: RSL fraud-model score, BP4 match results, BP1 data quality and an optional group risk rating

acceptance.text: Lane targets (fast 10, standard 30 working days; investigation case plan 5, target 90) live in versioned configuration marked 'proposed, verify against VAT Act' and each lane proposal carries its target and due date

The undisputed portion is computed deterministically as the reconciled amount and shown as a recommendation for the refund auditor; the system never releases or denies payment; disputed items are listed for the targeted request

The lane reason cites each input used (RSL score with model version, IDMS match share, data quality, group rating or 'not available'); a missing input never silently counts as clean; tests cover each lane, partial release and missing-input cases
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: The lane reason cites each input used (RSL score with model version, IDMS match share, data quality, group rating or 'not available'); a missing input never silently counts as clean; tests cover each lane, partial release and missing-input cases

evidence.text: ai/tools/refund_triage_policy.json (status proposed_prototype_choice, 'verify against the VAT Act'): fast 10, standard 30, investigation plan 5 / target 90 working days; each lane proposal carries target and due date (weekdays; holidays not modelled).
undisputed_amount = claim less VAT on disputed lines (IDMS gaps and invoices not in the books, counted once), status recommendation_for_refund_auditor; decision None; disputed items listed.

Lane inputs cite RSL score with model ID/version, IDMS match counts, books check, zero-rated share, group rating 'not available'; missing score stated (test_missing_inputs_are_stated_not_assumed_clean); score alone never investigation; TriageTests cover each lane, partial release and missing inputs.

PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/277. python3 scripts/dev.py check: Workspace checks passed; python3 scripts/quality.py: First-party quality checks passed (ruff, mypy, frontend build); validate.py passed.
